[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Implementing irrigation systems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Implementing shade-grown coffee systems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Applying fungicides to control coffee rust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Using improved agricultural practices like soil conservation and crop rotation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that these measures aim to protect crops and mitigate weather impacts but can involve significant costs and require additional resources.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that the measures have significantly impacted the coffee industry, helping to stabilize production despite ongoing threats from climate change.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant referenced the Central American coffee crisis of the early 2000s, where coffee rust severely impacted production.
